question: Identify outliers in all numeric columns using the IQR method (values < Q1 - 1.5xIQR or > Q3 + 1.5xIQR). Cap these outliers at the upper and lower bounds.

expected_output.guidelines: Capped values must match the reference within 1% relative absolute error; non-outlier values must be unchanged; row order, column order, and header labels may differ.
